role: Independent actual-raw review of completed original-author cumulative reward curves; stdlib only

execution.memory_scope: Shared cgroup v1 container, not one job memory

replica_policy: First occurrence in rank0 then rank1 raw case order; entire duplicate explicitly preserved separately, not counted twice or averaged into population

source_interpretation.rule_evidence: Local original ft_ifr_improve bytes SHA583f4b7d match actual imported owner; with negative factual-minus-fully-deleted endpoint, the initial normalized value clips to0 and the running minimum makes every normalized point0. No metric is changed here.
source_interpretation.risk: 13/21 allzero original normalized curves and small RISE do not establish absent intermediate deletion effect or excellent attribution quality. Metric endpoint normalization is distinct from raw same-set LP evidence.
source_interpretation.positive_view_same_set_sum: The positive-MAS order/density uses clamped FP32 d; reported same_set_saved_d_sum always sums the original signed saved d over that actual cumulative deleted set, including final low/negative groups. It is not an all-positive reward allocation.
source_interpretation.endpoint_vs_conditionals: Full-source endpoint scalar agreement does not establish every nested set, single-token deletion or PPO learning-signal accuracy.
